_comment: Mode sizecliff_q35_2b (A-PREREG-SIZECLIFF (PREREG.md on origin/state, agent-a 2026-10-09 ~23:20Z, registered before any run): same recipe, same data draw, same LoRA rank and clock on Qwen/Qwen3.5-0.8B, -2B, -4B; PRIMARY readout = the H2O-Lightning shim format (coordinator amendment 2026-10-09, before any run: host scan job-zbtbj stock Qwen3.5-4B open-I 56.3 shim vs 46.1 v3w), trained in that same format (train == serve); screen = proxy600 (cross-readout vs the D1+v3w reference and the Clef-flash / Clef 27B units) + jevkit on the 231 public JevBench items (shim native; v3w and the shim post-processing score-only); the 4B is also rescored with the lean shim prompt. LiquidAI/LFM2.5-2.6B-Base is NOT an arm: transformers' Lfm2ShortConv cached path is single-token decode only (causal_conv1d_update / one conv step once the cache holds a state), so the cache fork (prefix once, K continuations in one call) is not exact for it without a new conv-state continuation patch + a GPU fork==recompute check (jobs/m2_first_cell/JOB_SPEC.md).) job_params_q9af_v2_v3w.json on the stock Qwen/Qwen3.5-2B parent: no conversion export, no parent arm (parent_arm none; screen_parent none: the screen pairs the child with the D1+v3w reference and the Clef-flash / Clef 27B proxy600 units, all cross-readout), then jevkit on the 231 public JevBench items in the same process (native shim; score-only: v3w on the same checkpoint and the shim's T 0.8 / yes-no floor post-processing). Schedule: setup 20 + guard 5 + heldout 10 + cell 130 + screen 45 + report 5 + reserve 7 = 222 = max_duration. Quoted hold 222 x $0.063 = $13.99; worst case (60 + 2 x 222) x 0.0495 = $24.95 (hard cap $30). Screen: fixed 15 (model load + lineage rebuild of the 94,786 training items: Qwen rows tokenize at ~400 records/s/process on the laptop + jevkit 2 x 233 serial requests) + D1's 25.97 proxy minutes = 40.97 <= 0.95 x 45.
